**sdd/issue-709-declaring-selector/spec**

**What**: Delta spec for issue #709 written to `openspec/changes/issue-709-declaring-selector/spec.md` in worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-709` (branch `fix/issue-709-declaring-selector`). Artifact store: hybrid. Content: REQ-639-1 MODIFIED (selector becomes fence TAG `​```brain-graph/1`, exact-case, first word — supersedes the `protocol:` scalar selection; `​```yaml`+`protocol:` no longer declares). ADDED: REQ-709-2 (shared `fenced-blocks.mjs` splitter MUST be CommonMark-correct across 14 axes — tag, delimiter, nesting both directions, run length, indentation 0/1-3/4+, blockquote, list-item, HTML comment, LF/CRLF, unterminated, info-string trailing attributes, case, multiplicity, position — table + GWT scenarios incl. the tilde-nesting attack and legal-indented-closer cases), REQ-709-3 (every refusal legible — named reason, right stream, ties to `evidence-reader-empty-on-failure` defect class), REQ-709-4 (regression net: `amendment-draft.test.mjs`, `checkpoint-block.test.mjs` + consumer suites MUST pass unedited — any edit is a STOP for the maintainer), REQ-709-5 (hard boundary: `review/lib/yaml-block.mjs` + 3 consumers `parse-verdict.mjs`/`decision-block.mjs`/`vcs/actor-check.mjs` untouched, zero-line diff, per signed ADR-0026 + REQ-487-6), REQ-709-6 (doctrine reversal of design.md:16-17's family table requires a signed ADR per ADR-0028 mechanics; human signature is an explicit PRECONDITION of closing the change — an agent MUST NOT apply `status:approved` or sign it, per #124/`actor-check` authority split).

**Why**: Encodes the proposal's decisions (`sdd/issue-709-declaring-selector/proposal`, id 2764) as testable requirements, and settles the #709/#710/PR-703 split the proposal left conditional.

**Where**: `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-709/openspec/changes/issue-709-declaring-selector/spec.md`. Verified myself against `b3c08a5` in-worktree: `brain/scripts/lib/fenced-blocks.mjs` (backtick-only `/^(`{3,})\s*([^`]*?)\s*$/`, exact-run-at-column-0 closer), `brain/scripts/status/epic-graph.mjs` (currently selects on `protocol:` scalar across all fences, REQ-639-3 multi-block error present), `brain/scripts/review/lib/yaml-block.mjs` (`scalar()` uses `^key:` with `m` flag — column-0-relative-to-block, confirming the orchestrator's claim that indentation is why #709/#710/#702/#690/#473 bodies parse to `null` today, not tag-safety by design). Also read `issue-639-graph-block-locator/spec.md` (REQ-639-1 full text, copied then edited) and `issue-495-declared-budget-claim/design.md:16-17` (family table confirmed as described).

**Learned**: No Bash/`gh` tool was actually available in this phase's toolset despite the launch prompt instructing `gh issue view 709/710` and `gh pr view 703` — I could not independently verify the #709/#710 issue bodies or PR #703's live state. I used Engram observations `brain/pr-703-hold` (#2753 — the cold-review decision that ORIGINATED #709/#710 with real corpus measurements: 318 issues, `GRAPH_FENCE_TAGS=['','yaml']` excludes 0/7 illustration sites, two regressions found) and `sdd/issue-709-declaring-selector/explore` (#2763 — independent corpus re-derivation, confirms the corpus tally is an analogy-based proxy not a literal `brain-graph/1` measurement) as the evidentiary basis for the split section, and flagged in the spec itself that a later phase MUST run a live `gh pr view 703` before archiving. This is a tooling gap the orchestrator should close before the next `gh`-dependent phase.
